Opened PR 52 by hand with the GitHub MCP create_pull_request tool on the pushed branch and the verifier merged it. Running tools/turn.mjs twice in a row leaves the first turn file in place and the second run then dry runs on top of it; delete earlier attempt files before rerunning.

entries.problems: First picker ignored tall fixtures drawn only as a closed outline at their top height (gondolas at 1524 mm), so people landed inside them; fixed with a point in polygon test over closed low outlines, excluding wall footprints and floor finishes. Separate site() instances per section forgot this turn's people, so extras landed on them; fixed by caching one site per chunk. One blink duty of 0.97 was rejected; duty must be 0.05 to 0.95. The detail cap in engine.js is per agent per chunk, not per building.

Zero overlaps on the clean run. Two shelf_height checks (900 and 1100 mm) were below the 1219 mm minimum; dropped them.
